title: Dip Powder Tutorial  - Perfecting OPI Powder Perfection
description:
#Howtododippowdernails #powderperfection #dippingpowdernails 

In this video I'm going to show you everything you need to know about OPI Powder Perfection. I've had a lot of requests for a video like this as the dipping powder systems aren't the most forgiving on the market. So if you are having trouble with any dipping powder system stay tuned as I'm going to show you some tips and tricks for an smooth and trouble free application.
